source.build_head_basis: git reflog: 1e204a5 was HEAD from 10:07:48 JST when the release example used by the matrix was written at 10:12 JST
worktree_changes_at_build: apps/desktop/examples/compare.rs (this slice's trace accounting extension; committed with this evidence)
crates/desktop-gpui/src/palette.rs (another lane's in-flight work; not part of this slice and not committed here)
source.reproducibility: NOT_VERIFIED: this is a shared checkout; the executed binary includes the uncommitted worktree changes listed above, so only its sha256 binds the executed bytes and a rebuild from a commit is not claimed to reproduce them

protocol.run_scope: each trace is the harness's own fixed 60 s command schedule
protocol.isolation: fresh LOCALAPPDATA/APPDATA/TEMP per run under a private scratch root
protocol.serialization: one native lock for the whole matrix; released afterwards
protocol.aggregation: per-sample achieved_us from the trace ledger; median=p50 of observed samples; p95=nearest rank ceil(n*0.95)-1; min/max exact
protocol.achieved_cadence_note: requested_us advances by 16 ms per sample but the measured loop cadence is the achieved_us interval distribution; it is observation-loop cadence, not frame pacing
protocol.camera_metric: pair_delta = hypot(anchor_a - anchor_b) from the trace camera tuple; linked state starts linked and toggles at step 64 and every 240 steps; the two samples after each re-link are treated as the re-synchronization transient; unlinked cross-pane change counts samples where a gesture targeted one side and the other side's camera tuple changed
protocol.fairness_scope: pane fairness is measured as per-pane camera/entry progress and cross-pane camera non-interference; window fairness is the two concurrently traced windows' own samples and counters under one process-wide upload service
protocol.raw_ledger_policy: raw JSONL ledgers stay private under target/ and are cited by sha256/bytes in runs.json; committed evidence carries the per-run summaries, distributions and digests

measurement_limits: Present, GPU, frame pacing, displayed/scanout and input-to-photon are NOT_MEASURED; the harness declares them so and this record repeats it
queue wait is the service's CPU preparation wait counter, not a GPU or compositor queue
camera coupling is derived from the trace's reported anchor/scale tuples, not from pixels
cross-window fairness in windows2 is judged from two concurrently traced windows' own samples/counters; the upload service counters are process-wide, so per-window attribution is not separable
unequal dimensions/orientations/aspect ratios/DPI, cursor-anchored zoom and physical 1:1 are NOT_MEASURED by this matrix
no numeric R0 ratification, product acceptance or R5 fairness PASS is claimed; the adoption rule is evaluated only over the measured CPU/cache facts
